option_relations.rationale: The option 'Acute traumatic cervical spinal cord injury' is a direct match for the initial part of the leaf label, which specifies 'Acute traumatic cervical spinal cord injury (complete) at C4-C5 with fracture-dislocation and spinal cord compression/ischemia'. The option is a slightly less specific but still equivalent description of the core diagnosis.

The option 'Cervical spinal cord injury (C4-C5) with spinal cord compression' is highly consistent with the leaf label 'Acute traumatic cervical spinal cord injury (complete) at C4-C5 with fracture-dislocation and spinal cord compression/ischemia'. It specifies the location and the presence of compression, which are key elements of the leaf.

The option 'Traumatic spinal cord injury with spinal cord compression and anterolisthesis' aligns well with the leaf label 'Acute traumatic cervical spinal cord injury (complete) at C4-C5 with fracture-dislocation and spinal cord compression/ischemia'. Anterolisthesis is a type of fracture-dislocation, and the other components match.

The option 'Complete spinal cord injury (SCI) at C4-C5 level with intramedullary hemorrhage' is a more specific description of the leaf 'Acute traumatic cervical spinal cord injury (complete) at C4-C5 with fracture-dislocation and spinal cord compression/ischemia'. The leaf implies a complete injury at C4-C5, and intramedullary hemorrhage is a common finding in severe traumatic SCI, making this option a subtype or more detailed description of the leaf.
